description: Self-contained Close CRM REST API workhorse. HTTP Basic auth (API key as username, blank password). Close has no native atomic upsert endpoint, so this resource emulates one via search-then-write: POST /data/search/ (Advanced Filtering) to find an existing Lead by email / phone / name / custom field, then PUT /lead/{id}/ or POST /lead/. Retries on 429 (sliding-window rate limit, backs off using the RateLimit response header) and 5xx.

outputs.description: CloseCrmResource with .get/.post/.put, find_lead_by_query (Advanced Filtering search), create_lead, update_lead, and upsert_lead (search-then-write). Consumed by close_crm_lead_upsert (sink) and by custom Dagster asset code that needs raw Close REST access.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Close API key. Sent as the HTTP Basic username with a blank password.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retry attempts on 429 (sliding-window rate limit) and 5xx.

name: Close CRM Resource
